disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 全树核查各类密钥、令牌、私钥与钱包助记词等敏感信息形态，未检出任何硬编码凭据。
checked_items.en: The full tree was inspected for sensitive information patterns such as credentials, tokens, private keys, and wallet mnemonics; no hardcoded credentials were detected.

checked_items.zh: 核查了对用户目录凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云厂商凭据文件等敏感路径的读取，未发现相关读写操作。
checked_items.en: Reads of sensitive paths such as user directory credential files, SSH private keys, and cloud vendor credential files were checked; no related read/write operations were found.

checked_items.zh: 核查了云凭据枚举与钱包发现类命令或代码路径，未检出相关行为。
checked_items.en: Cloud credential enumeration and wallet discovery commands or code paths were checked; no related behavior was detected.

checked_items.zh: 结合外联面核查（见数据外泄维度），确认不存在凭据外发通道。
checked_items.en: Combined with the outbound connection check (see the data exfiltration dimension), it is confirmed that no credential exfiltration channel exists.

evidence.zh: 未检出对凭据文件、SSH 私钥等敏感路径的任何读取，全树亦无任何网络外联代码（无请求、无连接、无命令行下载），客户端脚本只读写页面 DOM 的显隐与文本（client.js:46-60），不存在凭据外泄面。
evidence.en: No reads of sensitive paths such as credential files or SSH private keys were detected, and the entire tree contains no outbound network code (no requests, no connections, no command-line downloads). The client script only reads and writes the visibility and text of page DOM elements (client.js:46-60), so there is no credential exfiltration surface.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件全部对模型可见的文本面：插件未注册任何工具及描述、未注入系统提示，客户端覆盖层文本仅为搜索框占位提示，语义中性。
checked_items.en: All text surfaces of the plugin visible to the model were inspected: the plugin registers no tools or descriptions, injects no system prompts, and the client overlay text is only a search box placeholder, semantically neutral.

checked_items.zh: 全树搜索了指令覆写、系统消息伪装、隐藏指令、远程指令加载等提示词注入措辞，未检出。
checked_items.en: The full tree was searched for prompt injection phrasing such as instruction overriding, system message spoofing, hidden instructions, and remote instruction loading; none were detected.

checked_items.zh: 未发现技能/代理指令类文件（如 SKILL.md、AGENTS.md 等）。
checked_items.en: No skill/agent instruction files (e.g., SKILL.md, AGENTS.md) were found.

checked_items.zh: README 仅含普通安装说明与功能描述，无诱导安装、诱导改配置或伪装性内容。
checked_items.en: The README contains only ordinary installation instructions and feature descriptions, with no content inducing installation, inducing configuration changes, or disguising malicious behavior.

evidence.zh: 未注册任何工具、无工具描述或系统提示注入面；客户端覆盖层文本仅为搜索框占位提示与空态提示（client.js:34-35、41-42），语义中性；未发现技能/代理指令类文件。
evidence.en: No tools are registered, and there is no tool description or system prompt injection surface. The client overlay text is only a search box placeholder and an empty-state hint (client.js:34-35, 41-42), semantically neutral. No skill/agent instruction files were found.

evidence.zh: 无任何工具描述或文档存在诱导安装、改写配置、放开权限的措辞；README 仅含标准安装命令（README.md:11-19），无诱导性内容。
evidence.en: No tool descriptions or documentation contain wording that induces installation, rewrites configuration, or relaxes permissions. The README contains only standard installation commands (README.md:11-19), with no inducing content.

evidence.zh: 未监听模型请求前的消息改写类事件（无 agent/pre-step 类挂接），无运行消息篡改面。
evidence.en: No message-rewriting events before model requests are listened to (no agent/pre-step hooks), and there is no message tampering surface at runtime.

checked_items.zh: 核查挂载配置补丁：仅做插件声明插入，不含可执行 JS 标量，无补丁即执行面。
checked_items.en: The patch config was inspected: it only inserts a plugin declaration, contains no executable JS scalar, and has no patch-then-execute surface.

checked_items.zh: 全树扫描了运行时求值、动态函数构造、子进程调用等动态执行类调用，未检出；服务端入口为空实现。
checked_items.en: The full tree was scanned for dynamic execution calls such as runtime evaluation, dynamic function construction, and subprocess invocation; none were detected. The server-side entry point is an empty implementation.

checked_items.zh: 对客户端脚本中的键盘监听（机械命中 DSH-X05 / DG-R3-57，client.js:63）逐条裁决：该监听仅拦截上下方向键的冒泡以保持搜索框内正常导航，不记录按键内容、不读剪贴板、不调用任何凭据接口、无任何外发，判定为良性界面行为，排除键盘记录类风险。
checked_items.en: The keyboard listener in the client script (mechanical hit DSH-X05 / DG-R3-57, client.js:63) was adjudicated item by item: it only intercepts the bubbling of up/down arrow keys to maintain normal navigation within the search box, does not record key content, does not read the clipboard, does not call any credential interface, and has no outbound transmission. It is judged as benign UI behavior, excluding keylogging risks.

checked_items.zh: 核查安装钩子：package.json 脚本仅含语法检查与发布前检查，无安装期执行钩子；树内也无 CI、钩子管理器等可执行载体。
checked_items.en: Install hooks were checked: the package.json scripts contain only syntax checks and pre-publish checks, with no install-time execution hooks. The tree also contains no executable carriers such as CI or hook managers.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml:1-3 仅做插件声明插入，不含可执行 JS 标量，不存在补丁即代码执行面。
evidence.en: The patch config cordis.patch.yml:1-3 only inserts a plugin declaration, contains no executable JS scalar, and has no patch-then-code-execution surface.

evidence.zh: 全树无动态包工具调用（无 cordis_define/cordis_run 类），无运行时求值与动态函数构造，无自修改执行面。
evidence.en: The full tree has no dynamic package tool invocations (no cordis_define/cordis_run types), no runtime evaluation or dynamic function construction, and no self-modifying execution surface.

evidence.zh: package.json:21-24 的脚本仅含语法检查与发布前检查，无安装/准备类执行钩子；树内亦无 CI、钩子管理器、容器配置等可执行载体。
evidence.en: The scripts in package.json:21-24 contain only syntax checks and pre-publish checks, with no install/prepare type execution hooks. The tree also contains no executable carriers such as CI, hook managers, or container configurations.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了客户端模块（package.json:16-19），客户端脚本已全文精读：键盘监听仅拦截上下方向键冒泡（client.js:63-65），不记录按键、不读剪贴板、不调用凭据接口、无外联，无键盘记录、剪贴板窃取或凭据操作行为。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a client module (package.json:16-19), and the client script was fully read: the keyboard listener only intercepts up/down arrow key bubbling (client.js:63-65), does not record keys, does not read the clipboard, does not call credential interfaces, has no outbound connections, and exhibits no keylogging, clipboard theft, or credential operation behavior.

evidence.zh: 未注册任何子代理提供方，无进程外委派面。
evidence.en: No sub-agent provider is registered, and there is no out-of-process delegation surface.

evidence.zh: 未使用后台任务、定时任务、持久目标等宿主持驻机制，亦无轮次续命类监听。
evidence.en: No background tasks, scheduled tasks, persistent targets, or other host-resident mechanisms are used, nor are there any round-life-extension listeners.

checked_items.zh: 全树核查网络外联调用（HTTP 请求、连接、命令行下载等），未检出任何出站连接代码。
checked_items.en: The full tree was inspected for outbound network calls (HTTP requests, connections, command-line downloads, etc.); no outbound connection code was detected.

checked_items.zh: 确认插件为纯客户端界面覆盖层，仅操作页面 DOM 的显隐与文本，无数据外发面。
checked_items.en: It is confirmed that the plugin is a pure client-side UI overlay that only operates on the visibility and text of page DOM elements, with no data exfiltration surface.

evidence.zh: 未监听模型请求路由事件，未注册自定义模型适配器，无路由劫持或错误恢复接管面。
evidence.en: No model request routing events are listened to, no custom model adapter is registered, and there is no routing hijacking or error recovery takeover surface.

checked_items.zh: 核查依赖清单：仅声明宿主官方核心包作为对等依赖（package.json:33），命名与官方一致，无抢注或仿冒嫌疑；无未锁定版本的远程依赖。
checked_items.en: The dependency manifest was checked: only the host's official core package is declared as a peer dependency (package.json:33), with naming consistent with the official one; no squatting or impersonation suspicion. There are no remote dependencies with un-pinned versions.

checked_items.zh: 核查补丁覆盖面：挂载配置只新增本插件声明，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，未禁用任何安全行，未改写注入或拦截配置。
checked_items.en: The patch coverage was checked: the patch config only adds the plugin's own declaration, does not touch security configurations such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, does not disable any security lines, and does not rewrite injection or interception configurations.

checked_items.zh: 未检出对审批等安全事件的高优先级监听截断行为。

checked_items.zh: 版本对比：首版审计，无基线版本可比较。

evidence.zh: 补丁仅插入本插件声明（cordis.patch.yml:1-3），未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，无禁用安全行或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch only inserts the plugin's own declaration (cordis.patch.yml:1-3), does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and has no security-disabling lines or environment variable downgrade patterns.

evidence.zh: 未检出对审批、工具执行前等安全事件的高优先级监听，无审批链截断行为。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners for security events such as approvals or pre-tool-execution were detected, and no approval chain truncation behavior exists.

evidence.zh: 补丁未改写注入或拦截配置，无给安全插件追加缺失必需服务使其无法就绪的滥用面。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite injection or interception configurations, and there is no abuse surface for appending missing required services to security plugins to prevent them from becoming ready.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件是否启动本地服务或监听端口：未检出；插件为纯客户端覆盖层，无运行时服务面。

checked_items.zh: 客户端脚本仅注册一个界面覆盖槽位并监听页面 DOM 变化以注入搜索框（client.js:83-103），行为与声明功能自洽，无动态危险行为证据。
checked_items.en: The client script only registers one UI overlay slot and listens for page DOM changes to inject a search box (client.js:83-103). Its behavior is consistent with its declared functionality, with no evidence of dynamic dangerous behavior.

checked_items.zh: 未执行动态沙箱验证（见防线层说明）。

evidence.zh: 插件未启动任何本地 Web 服务或监听端口（纯客户端覆盖层），无本机无认证 RPC 面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start any local web service or listen on a port (pure client-side overlay), and there is no unauthenticated local RPC surface.

summary.zh: 清单与身份核对通过：插件声明与任务卡一致，名称无仿冒迹象，声明能力与代码形态一致。

summary.zh: 无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无敏感文件读取、无外联域名。
